entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. This call may be monitored and is a recorded line for quality assurance. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'm calling about a VeloBand Pulse I ordered last week. The order number is VP78945.

Thank you for calling, and thank you for being a valued VeloFit customer. Let me pull up order VP78945. Okay, I see it here. The estimated delivery date is currently showing as approximately... 90 days from today.

Actually, I apologize. I was just looking at the general estimate. Let me check the specific details for your order... oh, it looks like there's been a slight update in the supply chain. It's now projecting closer to 120 days.
120 days?! You just said 90 days! That's unacceptable. I'm a VIP Platinum member. I expect better service! You promised me 90 days!

Sir, I understand your frustration. I am very sorry for the incorrect information. The system had a delay in updating. It wasn't my intention to mislead you in any way. I certainly wasn't lying. I understand this feels like a bait and switch, but that wasn’t the intention. We really value your business.
So, what are you going to do about it? I was counting on that VeloBand Pulse.

Because of your Loyalty Status as a VIP Platinum member, I'm going to override the current estimate. We'll prioritize your order and ensure it ships within the 90 days I initially quoted. I know the system says 120, but I’m making an exception for you. I'll personally monitor its progress and send you updates every week.
Yes, sir. I’ve already flagged the order for expedited processing and confirmed it with my supervisor. Again, I apologize for the initial confusion. We value your loyalty to VeloFit.
Okay, I appreciate that. Thank you for taking care of it. So, definitely within 90 days?
Absolutely. I've made a note on your account and will personally ensure it ships within that timeframe. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's all. Thanks again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for being a valued VeloFit customer. Have a great day!
